QuestInfo.name: [Battle Mode] Battle Training
QuestInfo.0: Get basic training from Haktorius before you participate in Battle Mode.
QuestInfo.1:
Listen to the explanation on the basic rules of Grand Battle.


#e#b<Grand Battle>#k#n

#ePeriod#n   #b>> Mon - Fri |#n #k4PM - 10PM
         #b>> Sat, Sun, Holiday | #k1PM - 10PM
#eReward#n   Gallant Emblem
#eRestrictions#n  
         Usage of select skills are restricted for safety, HP enhanced
QuestInfo.2:
#e#b<Battle Mode, Grand Battle Grand Opening>#k#n

#ePeriod#n   #b>> Mon - Fri |#n #k4PM - 10PM
         #b>> Sat, Sun, Holiday | #k1PM - 10PM
#eReward#n   Gallant Emblems
#eRestrictions#n  
         Some skills will be disabled; your HP will be enhanced

Gallant Emblems will be granted to active participants. Use them to purchase useful items!

0.0: You are now my trainee. Keep your ears open and your head down.\r\nNow listen up while I explain the rules.

yes.0: Your training will end on #bTKTKTK#k. Until then, you're responsible for your own training and battle prep. DO NOT MISS YOUR TRAINING SESSIONS. They take place from #e#b4PM to 10PM on weekdays#k#n and from #e#b1PM to 10PM on weekends and holidays#k#n. Use the #r#eGrand Battle#k#n to increase your skills by sparring against other trainees.

no.0: Did your weak heart decide to tuck tail and run, or is it just following your weak mind?

1.0: The Grand Battle is just like a real fight, only #r#eselect skills aren't permitted#k#n. Trust me, it's for your own good. You should be prepared. Open the Skill Window (K) and see what you're going to be missing. Once training starts, there will be no mercy.\r\nNow, obviously, some recruits are going to have an advantage in the HP department. To make up for that, people on the lower end of the spectrum will have their #e#bHP enhanced#k#n while in the Training Room.\r\n

yes.0: Your primary goal in Battle Mode, besides irrefutable victory, will be to fill your Gallant Gauge. It will be the only way for you to earn Gallant Emblems and they will be the only way for you to earn the equipment you will need for the fight against the Black Mage. Trust me, you'll want to follow my advice.
